speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: At Farrer Park MRT station, there is only one exit that has access from the basement to the street level.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: This has caused quite a bit of inconvenience for my residents who are wheel-chair bound.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: For instances like these, could there also be a full study of barrier-free accessibility for these areas?

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: Also, is it possible for the Minister to consider whether for neighbourhoods with a higher percentage of elderly, there could be a full package of support covering traffic lights, duration of traffic lights, distance of traffic lights from the residences and also the overhead bridge lifts as well?

speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
text: Besides railways, their accessibility and reliability, a big part of this will be first-mile-last-mile connectivity.

speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
text: How do we bring a commuter from his or her home to where he or she wants to go?

speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
text: Barrier-free access for both young and old and, especially, the vulnerable, would be a key part.

speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
text: As for the specific question on Farrer Park MRT station, I would have to check because I am not familiar with the station.

speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
text: Although I have been taking trains, I have not visited all the stations yet.

speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
text: Farrer Park, we will have to take a look.

speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
text: I have spoken on this topic for the past three years in Parliament, asking for an elevator to be built in my ward.

speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
text: Yes, Madam, I recall hearing the conversation between the Member and my predecessor about his needs in Mountbatten ward.

speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
text: I thought that Mr Lui Tuck Yew at that time had already responded to some of his requests.

speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
text: As to the specific recent requests, we have to take a look.

speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
text: We will roll it out as quickly as we can because this is important, especially as our citizens become more elderly.

speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
text: This is a very important part of how to make sure that their quality of life and day-to-day moving around can be enhanced.

speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
text: The alternative is, the seniors get stuck and do not move around as much.

speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
text: This will have huge implications for my previous Ministry, MOH.

speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
text: We do not make any distinction between public or private estates; we are all Singaporeans.

speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
text: Often, in some of the projects, the HDB estates get priority, not because we favour public versus private estates, but it is because their sheer needs are heavier.
